lines.en: label rinspringnightgen:
scene rinspringnightgen
I call Rin and get roped into joining her at the convenience store for a late night snack because I am a pushover who never says no to attention.
lines.zh: 我给 Rin 打了电话，结果被她拖着一起去便利店吃夜宵，因为我就是个从不拒绝别人关注的软柿子。

lines.en: Thanks to a raise she received following Christmas this year, she's now making a bit more money than she used to and offers to buy me a drink.
lines.zh: 托今年圣诞节之后那次加薪的福，她现在赚的比从前多了些，于是提出要请我喝一杯。

lines.en: I think she's only offering because she can sense that something is wrong. Which means that the only course of action for me is to deny her offer and ultimately die of thirst.
lines.zh: 我觉得她之所以要请，只是因为她察觉到了不对劲。也就是说，我唯一的行动方针就是拒绝她的好意，然后最终渴死。

lines.en: She has trouble taking no for an answer.
lines.zh: 她很难接受「不」这个答案。

lines.en: I have trouble thinking that without wanting to throw myself at her.
lines.zh: 我也很难在这么想着的时候，不产生想扑向她的念头。

lines.en: scene black
But I manage to avoid doing that because she's my friend. Or my surrogate daughter. Or whatever she's supposed to be to me at this point.
lines.zh: 不过我总算忍住了，因为她是我的朋友。或者是我代理意义上的女儿。又或者，到了这个地步，她对我而言算是别的什么。

lines.en: The lines that draw our relationship have gone so blurry to me that I often forget what I am to her. It's fine, though, because I'm sure she'll remind me soon enough.
lines.zh: 划定我们关系的那些线，在我眼里已经模糊到让我常常忘记自己对她算什么。不过没关系，因为我敢肯定她很快就会提醒我的。

lines.en: The two of us will leave this place and we'll spread apart, thinking about each other as we head in different directions.
lines.zh: 我们两个会离开这个地方，然后各奔东西，朝着不同的方向走去，同时想着彼此。

lines.en: But her thoughts of me will linger for longer than my thoughts of her will.
lines.zh: 但她对我的念想，会比我对她的念想停留得更久。

lines.en: Not because she likes me more-
But because I'm trying to protect her.
lines.zh: 而是因为我在试图保护她。
